input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Fear No Evil"?

documents.text: Fear No Evil (Slaughter album) Fear No Evil is the third studio album by American glam metal band Slaughter. The record was completed while the band was still signed by Chrysalis in 1994. It was finally released in 1995 with CMC International Records. The album was preceded by the troubles and controversies of the band. Singer Mark Slaughter came from a nodule surgery on his vocal cords (1992), guitarist Tim Kelly was charged with drug trafficking, and bassist Dana Strum was rehabilitating from a dirt bike accident that injured his playing hand.
